assistantRule: Up to two assistants contribute capped +1 each when their Crafting proficiency is relevant; helpers gain observation progress, not full crafter credit.
failureSafety: No ordinary failed craft destroys a unique chosen item. Volatile materials may be partly lost only after a visible warning.
materialSubstitution: Recipes define explicit substitution groups; arbitrary substitutions are illegal.

repair.durabilityNotTedium: Durability primarily follows injuries, boss failures, and explicit hazards; ordinary attacks do not constantly degrade gear.
